settings.about: Vasudev Multispeciality Hospital opened in Daganiya, Raipur in 2021 with one aim: give families in Raipur dependable specialist care close to home. Under one roof we run round-the-clock emergency and ICU care, a modern dialysis unit in partnership with Apollo Dialysis Clinic, modular operation theatres, and in-house CT, sonography, digital X-ray and laboratory services. Our consultants cover kidney care, urology, surgery, women's health, orthopaedics, neurology, child health and more.
settings.mission: Deliver patient-centred care that combines sound clinical practice with compassion, using modern technology while keeping treatment affordable and accessible.
settings.vision: To be the most trusted healthcare provider in Central India, known for clinical excellence and caring service.
goals: Run a centre of excellence for specialist care
Keep a sharp focus on high-quality services

Treat every patient with respect, with affordable, ethical care

rules: Collect a visitor pass from the reception desk.
Children under 12 are not allowed in patient-care areas.
Sanitise your hands before and after visiting a patient.
Wear a mask that covers your nose and mouth.
Please do not visit if you have a cough, fever or other infection.
Mobile phones are not allowed in the ICU, CCU and critical-care areas.
Photography and video recording are not permitted.
Flowers and outside food need approval from the nursing staff.
Smoking, alcohol and tobacco are strictly prohibited on campus.
